Example: actual growth 2% and potential 3% gives a gap of −1%, so with an Okun coefficient of 2 the unemployment rate rises by about 0.5 percentage points.

map.奥肯定律（本页代码口径）：Δu = −0.5×(g−g*)（百分点，g 实际 G: Okun's law (this page's code basis): Δu = −0.5×(g−g*) (percentage points, g actual GDP growth in %, g* potential growth in %, 0.5 the Okun coefficient); linked values: growth gap = g−g*, magnitude = |Δu|, relative growth gap = (g−g*)÷(|g*|||1)×100 (%, with the denominator falling back to 1 when g* is 0). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; when actual growth is 2 percentage points below potential, unemployment rises by about 1 percentage point.
